Loss of control due to spatial disorientation.

The pilot’s failure to maintain directional control during landing that resulted in a runway excursion and collision with a pole.

The pilot experiencing an episode of impaired behavior and incapacitation for reasons that could not be determined based on the available information.
The failure of the landing gear to extend due to the failure of a hydraulic line.
A loss of power to the right engine for undetermined reasons.
